احتميت (form VIII)
# اِحْتَمَيْتُ (iḥtamaytu) /iħ.ta.maj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
# اِحْتَمَيْتَ (iḥtamayta) /iħ.ta.maj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
# اِحْتَمَيْتِ (iḥtamayti) /iħ.ta.maj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
# اُحْتُمِيتُ (uḥtumītu) /uħ.tu.miː.tu/: first-person singular
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
